BT SOCKS5 代理線路的最大連線數。代理多在 CGNAT 後可達 peer: Maximum connections for BT SOCKS5 proxy lines. Proxies are often behind CGNAT and can reach few peers, so setting connections too high only creates dead-connection churn and slows the overall download (recommended 20-40).

BT 直連線路的最大連線數。直連有公網 IP、可雙向連線，可設較高（如 200-: Maximum connections for BT direct lines. Direct lines have a public IP and can connect both ways, so a higher value (e.g. 200-500) is fine to boost download speed. 0 = use libtorrent default.
BT 直連線路的監聽埠。固定埠＋UPnP/NAT-PMP 可讓外部 peer 主: Listen port for BT direct lines. A fixed port plus UPnP/NAT-PMP lets external peers connect in and increases the number of reachable peers; 0 = dynamic port. Only affects direct lines, not proxy lines.
